mentions.name: Lunara AI
mentions.description: A meditation app where an LLM guides sessions without back-and-forth chat. Users set their preferences up front (style, duration, focus), and the app delivers a structured meditation session end-to-end. It is live on the App Store.
mentions.source_excerpt: It’s a meditation app where an LLM guides you without the usual back-and-forth chat. You set your preferences up front (style, duration, focus), then it delivers a structured session end-to-end.
